title: evolve wave: review follow-ups (one json flag source, a tested retry, the close order, the unknown start time) and a hermetic ledger test
routed_reason: the console owns the wave verbs and the boundary
source: console, 2026-10-08, delta review (round 2) of lane cl-wave-cli, verdict SHIP, LOW items
summary: Five LOW items from the round-2 review of evolve wave, plus one test defect found by the lane. 1: cmd_wave_next.go:97 decides --json with slices.Contains, apart from the flag parser. 2: the record save retry (waveRecordAttempts=2) has no fail-once-then-pass test. 3: closeLastWave saves the old record as closed before the new record exists. 4: an unknown process start time passes the pid check with no warning. 5: adapters/ledger TestSeal_RealLedgerCopy copies the real ledger of the worktree, so a short local ledger file made it fail.
fix: 1: parseWaveNextArgs sets the json flag and runWaveNext reads it back. 2: add a test where the first save fails and the second passes. 3: document the order in wave-operations.md, or close the old record after the new save. 4: write one WARN when the start time is unknown. 5: make the ledger test build its own fixture ledger.
